rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when introducing or shifting to a topic, such as your mental state.

example.english: Concerning your being so nervous, I really don’t understand why.
example.traditional: 講到你咁緊張，我真係唔明點解。
example.jyutping: gong2 dou3 nei5 gam3 gan2 zoeng1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 ming4 dim2 gaai2

rows.note: Use this straightforward equivalent when A is the subject being discussed, especially in more careful speech or writing.

example.english: Concerning this project, the report isn’t finished yet.
example.traditional: 關於今次個計劃，報告仲未完成。
example.jyutping: gwaan1 jyu1 gam1 ci3 go3 gai3 waak6 bou3 gou3 zung6 mei6 jyun4 sing4

rows.note: Use this when moving on to A or contrasting A with something mentioned earlier.

example.traditional: 至於食飯嗰樣，我哋遲啲先決定。
example.jyutping: zi3 jyu1 sik6 faan6 go2 joeng6 ngo5 dei6 ci4 di1 sin1 kyut3 ding6
